title: AI Application Developer: Building Production-Ready LLM Apps with RAG
description: A hands-on, project-based course that takes you from Python fundamentals to deploying retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) applications powered by large language models. You'll build a portfolio-ready AI app that answers questions over custom documents using embeddings, a vector store, and an LLM, while applying best practices in prompt design, evaluation, and deployment.
audience: Aspiring AI Application Developers with basic programming exposure who want to build and ship real LLM-powered applications.

moduleTitles.1: Building a RAG-Powered LLM Application in Python
